text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the Trainer's instructions, 
Tosen Jordan makes artificial nail tips 
inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through those actions, her keen eye of 
observation was honed. Yet as she grew, 
she also came to realize... that she 
wasn't drawing nearly as much attention as 
those around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running single-mindedly as if to shake off 
the haze in her heart, she was approached 
for an interview by a reporter whose 
interest was piqued by the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, in that very instant, what struck 
Tosen Jordan was— excruciating pain. Her 
hoof... had cracked.
